subskills.description: Locate explicit information (name, number, time, place, fact) stated in the source.
Match information to a restated (paraphrased) version of it.
Identify the overall topic, main point or conclusion of a text or recording.
Draw a conclusion that is implied but not stated.
Identify a speaker's or writer's opinion, attitude or claim.
Follow how a text/recording is organised (signposting, sequence, paragraph function).
Identify why something is said or included.
Resolve what a pronoun or reference expression points to.
Infer the meaning of a word or phrase from context.
Judge whether a statement agrees with, contradicts, or is not addressed by the source.
Select the final/confirmed information when earlier options are changed, corrected or rejected.

cognitive_processes.description: Go beyond the text to implied meaning.
Combine information across parts of the source.
Judge a claim against the source.

error_categories.description: Failed to locate or notice information stated explicitly.
Picked information from a different part of the source than the one asked about.
Chose an option that was proposed, rejected or corrected before the final information.
Attributed information to the wrong speaker.
Did not recognise a restated version of the information.
Chose a plausible but unsupported conclusion.
Misread what a reference word points to.
Took a supporting detail for the main idea (or vice versa).
Misread a grammatical structure (e.g. negation, comparison).
Confused similar numbers, times, dates or amounts.
Missed that the source contradicts the statement.
Could not find the relevant evidence (e.g. chose Not Given when it is stated).
Chose an option because it is topically related, without evidence.
No reliable hypothesis can be made from the item alone.
